scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w server
